value.rationale: A sharp quantitative operator-order stability estimate for the natural scaled self-adjoint partial-isometry class, permitting arbitrary noncommuting imaginary parts and spectra with a kernel. It closes the exponent gap from the published all-operator 1/8 estimate to the sharp scalar 1/2 obstruction for this structurally motivated class and determines the exact fixed-real-part supremum. This is more than a scalar corollary because the estimate holds for genuinely nonnormal T.
